metadata.title: Topological and spectral rigidity of hypersurface Zoll manifolds
metadata.abstract: We show that manifolds admitting Zoll families of minimal hypersurfaces are diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{S}^{n}$ or to $\mathbb{R}\mathbb{P}^{n}$, and we characterize their Zoll families in both cases. Then, we prove that a metric on $\mathbb{R}\mathbb{P}^3$ is surface Zoll if and only if its projective widths are all equal. Our last result asserts that a closed surface with the first four widths equal to $2\pi$ is isometric to $\mathbb{R}\mathbb{P}^2$ with its constant curvature one metric.

analysis.workSummary: 分类具有极小超曲面 Zoll 族的流形拓扑为球面或实射影空间，并用射影宽度刻画 RP³ 的 surface Zoll 度量及 RP² 的谱刚性。
techniques: 极小超曲面 Zoll 族
analysis.breakthrough: 把闭极小超曲面族的全局结构同拓扑和宽度序列联系。
analysis.limitations: RP³ 的等宽刻画与闭曲面前四宽度等于2π的刚性是不同陈述；不能将其推广为任意维数同样的谱判据。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
